column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key.
# Recorded on the Mac (DM_PSO_MANIFEST=off DM_PSO_RECORD): boot, the opening movie, the dialogue, the first battle map to its enemy phase.

# Then, below the Mac rows and their own note, an iPhone 18 Pro Max's Documents/pso_user.tsv from the owner's play on X1.0 (v131072): the rows the Mac list did not hold, 474 rows: 220 S, 241 R, 13 C. In all 2285 rows: 1563 S, 683 R, 39 C.

# Recorded on an iPhone 18 Pro Max from the owner's play on X1.0 (6448f757, chain 222e58e346d6, v131072), handheld, Picture Stretch, no upscaling, no edge smoothing, Frame rate 60: Documents/pso_user.tsv after the first start of a fresh install (an empty device archive; the 1811 Mac rows above prepared before the first frame) and about 18.7 minutes from boot (55,800 frames), which records only the rows the list above did not hold, 474 rows: 220 S, 241 R, 13 C. In all 2285 rows: 1563 S, 683 R, 39 C.

# The S rows are libraries its draws loaded that the Mac rows do not name; the R rows are the render pipelines its draws built in play (185 bases compiled, 5 frames over 100 ms with new pipelines, up to 336 ms); the C rows are the compute shaders it dispatched. Handheld and Picture Stretch change no pipeline key: the stretch is the host's present, and a row's pipeline key (pso_skey) holds no picture size. Row order = first-use order; do not sort. Checked with dm/tools/pso_seed.py check: no row refused.

# Grown on 2026-11-16 from the same iPhone 18 Pro Max's Documents/pso_user.tsv after two X2.0 sessions (build 431d5d18, about 35 min, 2026-11-15; build 29dcbb4d, about 9 min, 2026-11-16; Picture Stretch, MetalFX default), which holds every row the shipped list lacked across them: 3711 rows (2058 S, 1608 R, 45 C) this list did not hold. The 2026-11-15 session compiled 687 bases in play; the 2026-11-16 one, with these rows prepared from the phone's own list, 77. Left out (--drop-invalid): its 9 rows the shader map does not hold (another game version's keys or non-library rows, which the prewarm drops). In all 5996 rows: 3621 S, 2291 R, 84 C.
# Grown on 2026-11-21 from the iPhone 18 Pro Max's Documents/pso_user.tsv after a short X2.0 session (build ccd735061, about 2 min, Balanced): 55 rows (3 S, 52 R, 0 C) the list lacked.
